3110896.condition: No obvious chips or cracks seen; base edge glaze frit as made.
3110896.reason: Signed dated John Campbell Tasmania double handled vase of good size, collectable Launceston maker.

3110898.findings: Miniature brown/treacle glaze wall pocket. Back impressed/incised 'Campbell' with '1935'(partly legible) and 'TAS' or similar and 'MD' style initials; partly obscured by glaze. Supports John Campbell attribution.
3110898.condition: No visible damage; glaze runs over marks.
3110898.reason: Signed John Campbell miniature wall pocket, collectable Tasmanian pottery, modest value.

3110899.findings: Nao (Lladro) reclining fox figure, glossy finish. Base mark not photographed.

3110900.findings: Ochre drip glaze ovoid vase. Base incised 'McHugh / Tasmania / 10' with a smaller incised mark above (possibly 'Rup' or initials). Supports McHugh (Launceston) attribution.

3110900.reason: Signed McHugh Tasmania pottery, collectable Launceston maker.
